_comment: Habitability scoring parameters and biochemistry type definitions. Weights are multiplied (product), not summed - any zero kills the score.
_comment_scoring_shape: Shape of every range subscore and of the gas score. Inside the optimal band the score is a gaussian whose half-width = optimal_half_width_sigmas x sigma; a zero-width band uses zero_width_fraction of the viable range. A required gas scores frac / (frac + gas_saturation_fraction); an optional (min_fraction 0) gas that is absent earns absent_optional_gas_credit of its weight.

scoring._comment: Each subscore maps an input value to 0.0-1.0. optimal_min/max = score 1.0, viable_min/max = score tapers to 0.0, outside viable = 0.0

temperature._comment: Temperature scoring is biochemistry-dependent - see biochemistry_types. This weight scales the best-matching biochemistry temp subscore.

atmosphere._comment: Scored by presence/fraction of required gases for the matched biochemistry. See biochemistry_types for gas requirements.

pressure._comment: Below 0.006 atm (triple point of water) no liquid possible. Above 100 atm biochemistry severely constrained.

gravity._comment: Affects organism morphology. Very low = no atmosphere retention, very high = limits complexity.

magnetic_shielding._comment: Below threshold stellar radiation sterilizes surface. Subsurface life possible but not modeled.

liquid_surface._comment: Ocean coverage. Zero is survivable (subsurface aquifers) but heavily penalized.

stellar_radiation._comment: Too low = insufficient energy for photosynthesis. Too high = UV sterilization.

tidal_energy._comment: Tidal heat flux as alternative energy source for chemolithotrophic life. Replaces stellar_radiation in energy score when tidal flux is the dominant energy source. Optimal range covers Io-like heating down to Earth internal flux levels. Upper viable bound well below tidal disruption ceiling (1e5 W/m²).

tidal_energy_gate._comment: Minimum tidal flux (W/m²) required for tidal energy score to substitute for stellar radiation in the energy subscore. Below this threshold the body is too tidally inactive to support chemolithotrophic metabolism. Reference: Earth internal heat flux ~0.09 W/m², Io ~2 W/m².

biochemistry_types._comment: Each type defines viable conditions. The system tests all types and selects the best-scoring match.

water_carbon.label: Water/Carbon
water_carbon.description: Earth-like life using water as solvent and carbon as structural backbone

required_gases._comment: Each gas has a minimum fraction to be considered present and a weight for scoring

O2.role: aerobic metabolism, not required for anaerobic life

water_carbon._comment_complexity: Water/carbon has the highest potential for complex life

ammonia_carbon.label: Ammonia/Carbon
ammonia_carbon.description: Life using ammonia as solvent - viable at temperatures too cold for liquid water
ammonia_carbon._comment_complexity: Ammonia biochemistry is theorized but likely limits complexity vs water

methane_carbon.label: Methane/Carbon
methane_carbon.description: Titan-like life using liquid methane/ethane as solvent at cryogenic temperatures
methane_carbon._comment_complexity: Extremely slow metabolism at cryogenic temps severely limits complexity

thermophilic_water.label: Thermophilic
thermophilic_water.description: Extremophile life in superheated water kept liquid by high pressure - deep-sea vent analogue

pressure._comment: High pressure required to keep water liquid above 100C

chemolithotrophic.label: Chemolithotrophic
chemolithotrophic.description: Life deriving energy from chemical reactions — volcanic outgassing, hydrothermal gradients, sulfur/iron cycling. No sunlight required. Analogous to deep-sea vent ecosystems on Earth.
chemolithotrophic._comment_energy: Flags this type as tidal-energy-dependent. Scored using tidal_energy subscore rather than stellar_radiation when tidal flux >= tidal_energy_gate.min_flux.

temperature._comment: Broad range covering psychrophilic to hyperthermophilic organisms. Upper end reflects known vent organisms surviving above 120C under pressure.

required_gases._comment: Electron donors and acceptors proxied through atmospheric composition.

SO2.role: sulfur compounds as electron donor — volcanic outgassing indicator

N2.role: nitrogen source for amino acid synthesis

pressure._comment: Lower optimal minimum than water/carbon — vent organisms can thrive at lower surface pressures if liquid water exists locally under pressure.

chemolithotrophic._comment_complexity: Energy-limited metabolism and absence of photosynthetic base constrains ecosystem complexity. Microbial and simple multicellular at best.

biosphere_tiers._comment: Habitability score thresholds that determine biosphere complexity. Final score = habitability_index * biochemistry.complexity_potential.

lifeless.description: No life - conditions too hostile for any known biochemistry

prebiotic.description: Complex organic chemistry but no self-replicating life

microbial.description: Single-celled organisms - prokaryote equivalents, biofilms, extremophiles

simple_multicellular.description: Colonial and simple multicellular life - algae, fungi, sponge equivalents

complex_multicellular.description: Differentiated organisms with organs, nervous systems - plant/animal equivalents

advanced.description: Potential for tool use, social structures, or sapience

no_life_override._comment: Hard cutoffs that force habitability to 0 regardless of other scores

conditions.reason: Pressure below triple point of any viable solvent
Above thermal decomposition of all known biomolecules
Below minimum for any theorized biochemistry

no_life_override._comment_tidal: Tidal atmosphere gate (moons.py): minimum 0.05 Me required for tidal outgassing to sustain atmosphere. Below this Jeans escape strips outgassed material regardless of flux.
